description: This file defines a microphone level monitor using AVFoundation to capture and process audio input levels, along with a SwiftUI view for visualizing the microphone level as a bar.

classes.name: MicLevelMonitor
classes.description: An actor responsible for monitoring microphone input levels, processing audio buffers to compute normalized levels, and managing the audio engine lifecycle.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the audio engine to monitor microphone levels, providing a callback for level updates.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the microphone level monitoring and resets the audio engine.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Smooths the level updates and executes the callback with the latest smoothed level.

methods.name: normalizedLevel
methods.description: Calculates the normalized audio level in range [0, 1] from an audio buffer.
